Corporate loans remain about 91% of net loans and corporate deposits 74.8% of deposits [results]. TradingView P/E 7.57/PB 2.14/ROE 33.35% are starting points only. Bank deposits are operating funding; generic debt/equity should not rank this bank against nonbanks.
